messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone, an update to the konfound R package (v 1.0.2) is now available on CRAN.

This update reflects a number of changes, particularly changes and improvements to how the konfound function works when the test_all argument (to quantify the robustness of every coefficient in a model) is set to true. Special thanks to J. Murphy for his testing, suggestions and edits, and feedback regarding these changes and improvements.

Documentation for the package is available here: file://localhost/Users/joshuarosenberg/Documents/konfound/docs/index.html

An interactive web application is also available here: https://jmichaelrosenberg.shinyapps.io/konfound-it/

--

Joshua M. Rosenberg <https://joshuamrosenberg.com/>
